capabilities: edit .mdoc files like other Markdown files
show Markdoc files in the file explorer
highlight Markdoc tags in the editor
disambiguation: Not for regular Markdown editing; it only adds support for Markdoc (.mdoc) files with basic tag highlighting.
extras: The README only covers manual installation (copying manifest.json, main.js and styles.css into a vault subdirectory) and provides no usage examples or screenshots in text.
problem: Obsidian does not recognize or open .mdoc Markdoc files, and offers no highlighting for Markdoc tags.
summary: Enables editing of Markdoc (.mdoc) files in Obsidian with basic syntax highlighting for Markdoc tags.
